metadata.authors: Dragoumani, Konstantina; Tzouganatou, Georgia; Emmanouil, Mary; Angelakis, Emmanouil
metadata.sequencingProtocol: Genomes were generated through amplicon sequencing of 1000 bp amplicons using a published RSV primer scheme. prepared using the Oxford Nanopore Technologies Native Barcoding Kit 24 V14 (SQK-NBD114.24), and sequencing was performed on a MinION Mk1D device using an R10.4.1 flow cell. Basecalling was performed using MinKNOW with the high-accuracy (HAC) basecalling model.
